data.title: Niantic Spatial and HMCI Are Building the Foundation for City of Rancho Cordova's First Digital Twin for Physical AI | Niantic Spatial, Inc.
data.description: Niantic Spatial is working with HMCI and the City of Rancho Cordova to build a city-scale digital twin for physical AI. Roughly four square kilometers of the city's Innovation Region has already been captured by drone and reconstructed into a simulation-ready environment. HMCI is running traffic simulations against it today.
